text: Shows several recipe boxes next to each other in a row. When there is no more room the boxes continue on the next row. Use it instead of {{Div|{{RecipeBox|...}}|...}}: all the boxes are made in one step, so the page uses far less of its size limit (boxes inside Div were counted several times, and a page with many of them stopped showing the last ones). Usage {{RecipeRow|9000309|9000263|9000277}} Every unnamed parameter is the craft ID of one box, in the order you write them. Any number works. em (optional): the space between the boxes, in em. The default is 0.5. Empty parameters are skipped. Needs Module:RecipeBox. No description. html:
Shows several recipe boxes next to each other in a row. When there is no more room the boxes continue on the next row. Use it instead of {{Div|{{RecipeBox|...}}|...}}: all the boxes are made in one step, so the page uses far less of its size limit (boxes inside Div were counted several times, and a page with many of them stopped showing the last ones).

Usage 

{{RecipeRow|9000309|9000263|9000277}}
  • Every unnamed parameter is the craft ID of one box, in the order you write them. Any number works.
  • em (optional): the space between the boxes, in em. The default is 0.5.
  • Empty parameters are skipped.
  • Needs Module:RecipeBox.

No description.
